questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Suman said, “I will go to a new school from tomorrow.”

options.text: Suman said that she would go to a new school from the next day.
Suman said that I will go to a new school from tomorrow.
Suman said that she will go to a new school from the next day.
Suman said she would be going to a new school from tomorrow.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Suman said that she would go to a new school from the next day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the steps to change the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• When the direct speech is in an assertive form, we follow the steps given below:
 
 
• Convert the sentence in the direct speech into assertive.
 
• The tense of reported speech is changed only when the reporting verb is in the past tense. 
 
• The reporting verb 'said' will remain the same.
 
• The connector 'that' will follow the removal of comma and inverted commas.​
 
• The personal pronouns will be changed according to the subject and object of the reporting verb.
 
• ​Here the 1st person 'I' will change into the 3rd person 'she' as per the object.
 
• The future simple tense i.e. 'will' will be changed to the past simple tense i.e. would.
 
• Words showing time and place are changed accordingly. (tomorrow- the next day)
 
 
 
• ​​At last line up the remaining part.

 

Following these steps, we get- *Suman said that she would go to a new school from the next day.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

He plucked a ripe mango.

options.text: A ripe mango has been plucked by him.
A ripe mango is plucked by him.
A ripe mango is being plucked by him.
A ripe mango was plucked by him.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **A ripe mango was plucked by him.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in an active voice form, hence we need to convert it into a passive voice form.
 
• Find the subject (He) and object (A ripe mango) of the sentence and exchange their places. 
 
• The given sentence is in the simple past tense. The passive verb form for simple past is: 
 
 
• was/were + past participle form of the verb.
 
• So, 'plucked' changes to 'was plucked'.
 
 
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

 ​

Following these steps, we get - *A ripe mango was plucked by him.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** *​​​​

 
• If the subject isn't clear, the agent (by + Sub.) needn't be mentioned in the passive voice.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *People follow this ritual all over the world. (active)*
 
• *This ritual is followed all over the world. (passive)*
